statements.status_notes: An explicit PolicyReference API call can retrieve an attacker-selected remote URI without sufficient protocol or address restrictions, enabling server-side request forgery. The Open Liberty security table identifies 26.0.0.7 as the fixed product release for this CVE. This image ships the later IBM Open Liberty 26.0.0.11 runtime from its checksum-pinned, signature-verified release archive without replacing the vendor bundles. The observed Neethi PURLs retain source/POM base versions of code in those vendor-rebuilt bundles; they do not indicate an unpatched standalone upstream installation. The vendor remediation therefore already exists in this product payload. This assessment is scoped to this Open Liberty image and does not assess arbitrary artifacts with the same base PURL. Vendor fixed-release record: https://openliberty.io/docs/latest/security-vulnerabilities.html. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-287c-fxr7-3w6c.
